## August 28 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 260)

This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **August 28** across American network radio and syndication, four eras of the U.S. Treasury Department's *Guest Star* musical broadcasts (1949 Frankie Carle boogie-woogie, 1955 Gisele MacKenzie singing Cole Porter, 1960 rockabilly queen Brenda Lee, and 1966 pop icon Nancy Sinatra), Joan Copeland and Joan Lorring in Henrik Ibsen's *A Doll's House*, and Lionel Barrymore & Agnes Moorehead in *Mayor of the Town* for Rinso (1944–1975):
